title: Securities Trading Policy

tiers.name: Sonic Employees
tiers.description: All Sonic Healthcare group employees and officers. Bound only by the General Prohibitions in 2.1 (no trading while aware of material non-public information, no procuring or tipping, extended to third-party products over Sonic securities and to options limiting economic risk).

tiers.name: Designated Officers
tiers.description: Directors of Sonic, CEOs of Sonic subsidiaries, senior finance and corporate staff including the Company Secretary, any other person notified directly or indirectly by the Managing Director, Finance Director or Company Secretary, and the connected persons of each of them. Bound by 2.2 as well as 2.1: trading only in Board-approved windows, no hedging of unvested or holding-locked equity scheme entitlements, no short-term trading or short selling, post-trade notification within 24 hours, and signature of the policy on pain of forfeiture of equity rewards.

tiers.name: Directors of Sonic
tiers.description: Directors of Sonic Healthcare Limited; Designated Officers who additionally must not enter margin lending or other secured financing arrangements in relation to Sonic securities without prior approval of the Chair and disclosure to the Board, and must lodge an Appendix 3Y with the Company Secretary within two business days of executing a trade.

tiers.name: Sonic's Chair
tiers.description: The Chair of Sonic Healthcare. Approves exceptions and secured financing arrangements for other Directors; the Chair's own exceptions and secured financing approvals are given by the Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee.

tiers.name: The Managing Director and Finance Director
tiers.description: Designated Officers who must obtain approval from the Chair of Sonic Healthcare before selling Sonic securities, in addition to trading only within an open window.

tiers.name: Connected persons
tiers.description: In relation to any Designated Officer: their spouse (including de facto relationships), children or step-children under 18, their nominee including an investment manager managing funds on their behalf, a trust of which they or a connected person is trustee or beneficiary, a partner acting as such, and a company they or a connected person controls. Each is itself a Designated Officer for the purposes of 2.2.

definitions.hedging_definition: products such as options which operate to limit the economic risk of security holdings in Sonic; and (for Designated Officers) transactions in products which limit the economic risk of participating in unvested entitlements or entitlements subject to a holding lock under any equity based remuneration schemes

windows.start_anchor: the business day after the public announcement of half year and year end results
the business day after Sonic's Annual General Meeting
any Sonic announcement which gives specific market guidance regarding the next annual result due to be reported

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: Sonic's Chair or Managing Director may impose other periods when Designated Officers are prohibited from trading because price sensitive, non-public information may exist. The policy does not say whether such a period is announced or confidential. Separately, the Board must specifically consider and approve the opening of each trading window, so a window does not open automatically.

rules.detail: For employees who are not Designated Officers the only constraint on derivatives is the insider trading prohibition, which is expressly extended to third-party products created over Sonic securities and to options limiting economic risk. There is no window, clearance or hedging restriction on this tier.
rules.evidence: The prohibitions described above also apply to trading in financial products issued or created over Sonic's securities by third parties, and to trading in associated products and products such as options which operate to limit the economic risk of security holdings in Sonic.

rules.detail: An OTC put or call written over Sonic securities is a financial product created over Sonic's securities by a third party, so trading in it is caught by 2.1 and by the 2.2 window restriction. No pre-clearance is required inside a window (except for sales by the Managing Director and Finance Director), but details must be given to the Company Secretary within 24 hours of execution.
rules.evidence: Designated Officers are only permitted to trade in the period of eight weeks commencing on the business day after the public announcement of half year and year end results, and the period of five weeks commencing on the business day after Sonic's Annual General Meeting.

rules.detail: Exchange-traded options and derivatives are within the definition of Sonic securities ('shares, options, derivatives, debt securities and any other financial products that are able to be traded on a financial market') and so may only be traded in an open window, free of inside information, and must be notified within 24 hours. Short-dated or short positions remain barred by the short-term trading and short selling prohibition.
rules.evidence: Sonic Employees are prohibited from buying or selling or otherwise trading Sonic securities (including shares, options, derivatives, debt securities and any other financial products that are able to be traded on a financial market) at any time

rules.detail: A derivative that limits the economic risk of participating in unvested equity scheme entitlements is banned outright, with no window or approval route. Derivatives that are not risk-limiting are not caught by this clause but remain subject to the window restriction.
rules.evidence: Designated Officers are also prohibited from entering into: transactions in products which limit the economic risk of participating in unvested entitlements or entitlements subject to a holding lock under any equity based remuneration schemes

rules.detail: Absolute prohibition on hedging unvested equity based remuneration entitlements; no exception, approval or hardship route is provided, and breach triggers forfeiture of equity rewards.
rules.evidence: transactions in products which limit the economic risk of participating in unvested entitlements or entitlements subject to a holding lock under any equity based remuneration schemes

rules.detail: Entitlements subject to a holding lock are treated the same as unvested entitlements, so shares delivered under an equity scheme but still locked cannot be hedged or collared until the lock is released.
rules.evidence: entitlements subject to a holding lock under any equity based remuneration schemes

rules.detail: The hedging ban is confined to unvested and holding-locked equity scheme entitlements. Hedging shares that are fully vested and free of a holding lock, or shares bought on market, is not prohibited; it is simply trading in a product that limits economic risk, permitted only within an open window, only if free of inside information, and notifiable to the Company Secretary within 24 hours.
rules.evidence: trading in associated products and products such as options which operate to limit the economic risk of security holdings in Sonic

rules.detail: The prohibition on hedging unvested or holding-locked entitlements is expressed to bind Designated Officers only. Employees below that threshold are restrained only by the insider trading prohibition as extended to risk-limiting products.
rules.evidence: Designated Officers are also prohibited from entering into: transactions in products which limit the economic risk of participating in unvested entitlements

rules.detail: Monetisation is not named. A collar, prepaid forward or similar over vested unlocked shares is trading in a product that limits economic risk of a Sonic holding, permitted only inside an open window and notifiable within 24 hours. If secured on the shares, the Director secured financing approval in 2.2 also applies. Over unvested or holding-locked entitlements the same structure is prohibited.
rules.evidence: products such as options which operate to limit the economic risk of security holdings in Sonic

rules.detail: Outright ban on short selling arrangements in Sonic securities for Designated Officers and their connected persons, with no approval route.
rules.evidence: Designated Officers are also prohibited from entering into: ... short-term trading and short selling arrangements in Sonic securities.

rules.detail: The short selling prohibition is drafted as a Designated Officer prohibition in 2.2; the General Prohibitions in 2.1 do not mention short selling, so it is not addressed for employees generally.
Securities lending or borrowing is not mentioned anywhere in the policy, for any tier, and the trading concept is not defined in a way that expressly captures it.

CFDs are not named. A CFD is a financial product created over Sonic's securities by a third party and so within 2.1; a short CFD is a short selling arrangement and is typically short-term trading, both prohibited for Designated Officers. A long CFD would fall back to the window restriction.
rules.evidence: short-term trading and short selling arrangements in Sonic securities.

rules.detail: Margin lending is not banned for directors: it requires prior approval of the Chair (or, for the Chair, the Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee) and disclosure of the arrangement to the Board. The policy is silent on margin calls, forced sales and price triggers.
rules.evidence: Directors of Sonic Healthcare Limited are also prohibited from entering into margin lending or other secured financing arrangements in relation to Sonic securities without the prior approval of the Chair (and for the Chair, the Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee) and disclosure of such arrangements to the Board.

rules.detail: The margin lending and secured financing clause is expressly confined to 'Directors of Sonic Healthcare Limited'. For Designated Officers who are not directors, including subsidiary CEOs and senior finance and corporate staff, the policy imposes no margin lending restriction at all.

Granting security over Sonic securities is not itself described as trading, but a director who charges or pledges shares to support a financing is entering a secured financing arrangement in relation to Sonic securities and so needs Chair approval and must disclose it to the Board. A charge unconnected with financing is not addressed.
rules.evidence: margin lending or other secured financing arrangements in relation to Sonic securities without the prior approval of the Chair

rules.detail: The wording extends beyond margin loans to 'other secured financing arrangements in relation to Sonic securities', which captures a bank loan secured on collared shares. Two conditions: prior approval of the Chair (Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee for the Chair) and disclosure of the arrangement to the Board. No timing, quantum, loan-to-value or price-trigger conditions are stated.
rules.evidence: Directors of Sonic Healthcare Limited are also prohibited from entering into margin lending or other secured financing arrangements in relation to Sonic securities without the prior approval of the Chair ... and disclosure of such arrangements to the Board.

rules.detail: No secured financing restriction applies to non-director Designated Officers or to Sonic Employees generally; the clause binds directors only.

Short-term trading arrangements in Sonic securities are prohibited outright for Designated Officers. No holding period, matching rule or definition of 'short-term' is given, so the characterisation is left to the approver's judgment.
rules.evidence: Designated Officers are also prohibited from entering into: ... short-term trading and short selling arrangements in Sonic securities.

clearance.approver: No routine pre-clearance while a window is open. Exceptions to trade outside a window are granted by Sonic's Chair (for other Directors), the Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee (for Sonic's Chair) and the Managing Director (for all other Designated Officers).
clearance.evidence: Following execution of any trading, all Designated Officers are required to provide details of the trades to the Company Secretary within 24 hours.

clearance.approver: Sonic's Chair for exceptions and for margin lending or other secured financing; the Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee where the applicant is the Chair. Board disclosure required for secured financing.
clearance.post_trade_to: Company Secretary (Appendix 3Y), who promptly notifies the ASX
clearance.post_trade_deadline: within two business days of executing (i.e. before settlement) any trade; trade details to the Company Secretary within 24 hours
clearance.evidence: Directors are therefore required to complete an Appendix 3Y and forward to the Company Secretary within two business days of executing (i.e. before settlement) any trade.

clearance.tier: The Managing Director and Finance Director
clearance.approver: Chair of Sonic Healthcare (approval required before selling Sonic securities)
clearance.evidence: The Managing Director and Finance Director are required to obtain approval from the Chair of Sonic Healthcare before selling Sonic securities.
All Sonic Healthcare group employees and officers, hereinafter described as "Sonic Employees" are bound by the policy in 2.1 below.

short_term.evidence: Designated Officers are also prohibited from entering into: ... short-term trading and short selling arrangements in Sonic securities.

exceptions.approver: Sonic's Chair (for other Directors), the Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee (for Sonic's Chair) or the Managing Director (for all other Designated Officers); written request and written grant, with a declaration that the officer holds no material non-public information
exceptions.evidence: Exceptions to this policy may be granted by Sonic's Chair (for other Directors), by the Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee (for Sonic's Chair) or by the Managing Director (for all other Designated Officers) in cases of severe financial hardship or exceptional circumstances

exceptions.approver: Sonic's Chair, the Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee or the Managing Director
exceptions.evidence: Exceptional circumstances would exist if a Designated Officer was required by a court order, or there were court enforceable undertakings or some other overriding legal or regulatory requirement to transfer or sell Sonic securities

Nothing in the Policy restricts Sonic Employees from exercising options over unissued Sonic shares (including those granted under the Sonic Employee Option Plan). Trading of the subsequently issued shares is however subject to the Prohibitions above.

trading which results in no change to the beneficial interest in the securities (eg transfers of Sonic's securities already held by a Sonic Employee into that Sonic Employee's superannuation fund or other saving scheme in which the Sonic Employee is a beneficiary)

an investment in, or trading in units of, a fund or other scheme (other than a scheme only investing in Sonic securities) where the assets of the fund or other scheme are invested at the discretion of a third party

exceptions.approver: Board approves the plan that determines the timing and structure of the offer
exceptions.evidence: trading under an offer or invitation made to all or most of Sonic's security holders, such as a rights issue, a share purchase plan, a dividend reinvestment plan and an equal access buy-back, where the plan that determines the timing and structure of the offer has been approved by the Board

exceptions.approver: the other trustees or the investment managers, independently of the Sonic Employee
exceptions.evidence: where a Sonic Employee is a trustee, trading in Sonic securities by that trust, provided that: (i) the Sonic Employee is not a beneficiary of the trust; and (ii) any decision to trade is taken by the other trustees or by the investment managers independently of the Sonic Employee.
if a Sonic Employee wishes to make an undertaking to accept, or to accept, a takeover offer

exceptions.approver: prior written clearance under the same procedures as exceptions to the Designated Officer prohibitions
exceptions.evidence: trading under a non-discretionary trading plan for which prior written clearance ... has been provided and where: (i) a Designated Officer entered the plan or amended the plan during a period when trading was allowed under 2.2 above; and (ii) the trading plan does not permit the Sonic Employee to exercise any influence or discretion over how, when, or whether to trade.

financing_disclosure: Directors of Sonic; trigger: entering into any margin lending or other secured financing arrangement in relation to Sonic securities; prior approval from Sonic's Chair (Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee where the applicant is the Chair) and disclosure of the arrangement to the Board; no deadline stated beyond the approval being prior

All Sonic Employees; trigger: beginning to have, ceasing to have, or a movement of at least 1% of Sonic's issued capital in, a substantial holding; notice to Sonic and to the ASX under the Corporations Act

external_documents: Sonic Employee Option Plan and Sonic's equity based remuneration schemes (source of the unvested and holding-lock entitlements)
ASX Appendix 3Y (director's change of interest notice)
exemption_authority: Sonic's Chair (for other Directors), the Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee (for Sonic's Chair) and the Managing Director (for all other Designated Officers) may grant exceptions in cases of severe financial hardship or exceptional circumstances, provided it is clear to a reasonable person that the officer holds no material non-public information and the officer declares this in the written request; the grantor determines the evidence required and the minimum practical period for which the clearance is valid. Both request and grant must be in writing. The exception power is framed around transferring or selling securities, and does not extend to the prohibitions on hedging unvested or holding-locked entitlements, short-term trading or short selling.

bespoke_clauses.topic: hedging ban limited to unvested and locked awards
bespoke_clauses.clause: Designated Officers are also prohibited from entering into: transactions in products which limit the economic risk of participating in unvested entitlements or entitlements subject to a holding lock under any equity based remuneration schemes.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is the decisive limit: the hedging prohibition does not reach vested, unlocked shares, so a collar over those shares is not banned, but the collateral pool must exclude anything still unvested or under a holding lock.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Directors of Sonic Healthcare Limited are also prohibited from entering into margin lending or other secured financing arrangements in relation to Sonic securities without the prior approval of the Chair (and for the Chair, the Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee) and disclosure of such arrangements to the Board.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The loan leg of a funded collar is available to a director on Chair approval plus Board disclosure rather than being prohibited, and the clause binds directors only, so non-director Designated Officers face no secured financing restriction at all.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Designated Officers are only permitted to trade in the period of eight weeks commencing on the business day after the public announcement of half year and year end results ... The Sonic Board of Directors must specifically consider and approve the opening of the "trading window" in each instance.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: This is a positive-permission regime: outside a Board-approved window a Designated Officer simply cannot trade, so entry, roll, restrike or unwind of a collar must be scheduled into a window that the Board has actually opened.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Designated Officers are required to commit to this by signing the Securities Trading Policy and will forfeit their equity rewards should they be found to be in breach.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A breach can extinguish the executive's unvested equity, which both removes future collateral and creates a strong incentive to structure conservatively; a bank should not lend against awards that a policy breach could forfeit.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Designated Officers are also prohibited from entering into: ... short-term trading and short selling arrangements in Sonic securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: With no defined period, a short-dated or early-terminable collar risks being characterised as a short-term trading arrangement, so tenor should be clearly long and the structure should not contain features that look like a synthetic short.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Sonic securities (including shares, options, derivatives, debt securities and any other financial products that are able to be traded on a financial market) ... The prohibitions described above also apply to trading in financial products issued or created over Sonic's securities by third parties.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The core definition is limited to products tradeable on a financial market, but the extension sentence sweeps in bilateral bank-created products over Sonic securities, so an OTC collar cannot be argued outside the policy.

bespoke_clauses.clause: any clearance to trade can be given or refused by the appropriate person in their discretion, without giving any reasons; a clearance to trade can be withdrawn if new information comes to light or there is a change in circumstances; ... a decision to refuse clearance is final and binding.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Where approval is needed (Chair approval for secured financing, or for a sale by the Managing Director or Finance Director) it is unreviewable and revocable up to execution, so the bank carries signing risk on the funded leg.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Sonic's Chair or Managing Director may impose other periods when Designated Officers are prohibited from trading because price sensitive, non-public information may exist.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: An open window can be shut at short notice without any stated disclosure obligation, which can strand a partially executed or maturing structure.

bespoke_clauses.clause: All Sonic share dealings by Directors must be promptly notified to the ASX by the Company Secretary. Directors are therefore required to complete an Appendix 3Y and forward to the Company Secretary within two business days of executing (i.e. before settlement) any trade.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Both derivative legs and any change in the nature of a director's interest arising from the collar and the security will become public via the Appendix 3Y within two business days.

bespoke_clauses.clause: In relation to any person under (a) to (d) above: their spouse ... their nominee, including an investment manager managing funds on their behalf; a trust of which they, or any of their connected persons ... are the trustee or beneficiary; ... a company which they or any of their connected persons ... control.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: A collar booked in a family trust, controlled company or through a discretionary investment manager is treated as the Designated Officer's own trade and must sit in a window.

This is an old policy that predates the market convention of banning all hedging by KMP; the absence of a general hedging ban should be confirmed against the current remuneration report and any equity plan rules before a bank relies on it.

summary: A funded collar is possible under this policy, and Sonic is unusually permissive by current ASX standards. The hedging prohibition in 2.2 reaches only products that limit the economic risk of unvested entitlements or entitlements subject to a holding lock under an equity based remuneration scheme, so a put and call over fully vested, unlocked shares is not prohibited; it is simply trading in a product created over Sonic securities, which a Designated Officer may do only inside a Board-approved trading window (eight weeks after half year and year end results, five weeks after the AGM, two weeks after specific guidance), free of inside information, with trade details to the Company Secretary within 24 hours and, for directors, an Appendix 3Y within two business days. The secured loan leg is likewise permitted rather than banned: a director must obtain the prior approval of the Chair (the Chair of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee if the applicant is the Chair) and disclose the arrangement to the Board, while non-director Designated Officers face no secured financing restriction at all. The principal constraints are the narrow windows, which can be closed at any time by the Chair or Managing Director, the undefined prohibition on short-term trading and short selling arrangements, which argues for a long tenor and no synthetic short features, and the forfeiture of equity rewards that follows any breach. Because the policy dates from 2016 and the equity plan rules are not before us, the vesting and holding-lock status of every share pledged should be verified before the structure is entered.
